author: Kushal
problem: Read N users, each with a name and a rating. Number the users 0 to N-1 in dictionary order of their names; the winner is the user numbered (sum of all ratings) mod N. Print the winner's name.
bug_description: S.sort() is inside the input loop, so the names are sorted together with empty placeholders while reading and later names land in the wrong slots.

comments.accurate: Sorts the names and prints the one at position (total rating mod N)
comments.wrong_behavior: Keeps the names sorted as they are read and prints the one at position (total rating mod N)
comments.wrong_location: Name sorting verified; check that the ratings are converted to int before summing
